tweet.text: “If it is a human thing to do to put something you want, because it’s useful, edible, or beautiful, into a bag… and then take it home with you, home being another, larger kind of pouch or bag, a container for people… if to do that is human, if that’s what it takes, then I am a human being after all. Fully, freely, gladly, for the first time.”
